name: worldmap_lod1
description: VUH-2341/2344 host segment: from a save point after HB 1, World Map -> Asteroid Sweep Gummi route -> first landing in the Land of Dragons, through the Bamboo Grove intro and Ping's forced party menu. The menu sequences were played live on 2026-10-17 (runs 20261017-020254 and 20261017-024539; docs/WORLD_MAP_TRAVEL.md). Steps marked UNCALIBRATED steer the ship with digital WASD from an HB 1 start and still need live tuning against their captures. The friend only follows; it is held from the map request until the host's LoD room.
